summary: An abrupt cleanup callback completion is reported through host-defined error handling rather than synchronously thrown from register/unregister.

semantics.cleanup_operation: abrupt completion stops that CleanupFinalizationRegistry invocation
semantics.host: HostEnqueueFinalizationRegistryCleanupJob reports the error by host-defined steps

tests.name: register remains synchronous normal
tests.input: const f=new FinalizationRegistry(()=>{throw 1}); const x={}; console.log(f.register(x,1))
tests.expected_behavior: prints undefined; any future cleanup error is host-reported
